import json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np
from datetime import datetime

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

research = data['research_milestones']['data']
industry = data['industry_milestones']['data']
regulation = data['regulation_milestones']['data']
investment = data['ai_investment']['data']

# Parse dates
def parse_date(d):
    return datetime.strptime(d, '%Y-%m')

for item in research:
    item['dt'] = parse_date(item['date'])
for item in industry:
    item['dt'] = parse_date(item['date'])
for item in regulation:
    item['dt'] = parse_date(item['date'])

# Setup figure with editorial style
plt.rcParams['font.family'] = 'DejaVu Sans'
plt.rcParams['font.size'] = 9
plt.rcParams['axes.linewidth'] = 0.8
plt.rcParams['axes.edgecolor'] = '#333333'

fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(16, 10))

# Color scheme - editorial, professional
colors = {
    'research': '#2E5AAC',      # deep blue
    'industry': '#C44E52',      # muted red
    'regulation': '#55A868',    # muted green
    'investment': '#8C8C8C',    # grey for line
    'critical': '#1a1a1a',
    'high': '#444444',
    'medium': '#777777'
}

# Y positions for tracks
track_y = {'Research': 3, 'Industry': 2, 'Regulation': 1}

# Significance sizes
sig_size = {'critical': 110, 'high': 70, 'medium': 40}

# Plot tracks background
for track, y in track_y.items():
    ax1.axhline(y=y, color='#E0E0E0', linewidth=1.5, zorder=0)

# Helper to plot milestones
def plot_milestones(milestones, track_name, color_key):
    for item in milestones:
        y = track_y[track_name]
        x = item['dt']
        sig = item['significance']
        size = sig_size.get(sig, 40)
        ax1.scatter(x, y, s=size, c=colors[color_key], edgecolors='white', linewidth=1.2, zorder=3, alpha=0.9)
        # Label above or below alternately to reduce overlap
        ax1.annotate(item['label'], (x, y), textcoords="offset points", xytext=(0, 14 if hash(item['label']) % 2 == 0 else -22),
                    ha='center', va='bottom' if hash(item['label']) % 2 == 0 else 'top',
                    fontsize=7.5, color='#222222', fontweight='bold' if sig == 'critical' else 'normal')

plot_milestones(research, 'Research', 'research')
plot_milestones(industry, 'Industry', 'industry')
plot_milestones(regulation, 'Regulation', 'regulation')

# Add track labels on left
for track, y in track_y.items():
    ax1.text(datetime(2009, 6, 1), y, track, ha='right', va='center', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=colors[track.lower()])

# X-axis setup
ax1.set_xlim(datetime(2009, 10, 1), datetime(2025, 6, 1))
ax1.set_ylim(0.3, 3.7)
ax1.set_yticks([])

# Year ticks
years = list(range(2010, 2026))
ax1.set_xticks([datetime(y, 1, 1) for y in years])
ax1.set_xticklabels([str(y) for y in years], fontsize=10, color='#333333')
ax1.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=11, color='#333333', fontweight='bold')

# Investment overlay on secondary axis
ax2 = ax1.twinx()
inv_years = [datetime(d['year'], 1, 1) for d in investment]
inv_vals = [d['investment'] for d in investment]
ax2.fill_between(inv_years, inv_vals, alpha=0.15, color=colors['investment'], zorder=1)
ax2.plot(inv_years, inv_vals, color=colors['investment'], linewidth=2.5, linestyle='--', zorder=2, label='AI Investment ($B)')
ax2.set_ylim(0, 160)
ax2.set_ylabel('Global Private AI Investment (Billion USD)', fontsize=11, color='#555555', fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#555555')

# Highlight ChatGPT inflection
chatgpt_date = datetime(2022, 11, 1)
ax1.axvline(x=chatgpt_date, color='#D4A017', linewidth=1.5, linestyle='-', alpha=0.7, zorder=1)
ax1.annotate('ChatGPT Launch\nNov 2022', xy=(chatgpt_date, 3.5), xytext=(datetime(2021, 3, 1), 3.55),
            fontsize=9, color='#B8860B', fontweight='bold',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#D4A017', lw=1.2))

# Highlight 2023-2024 density
ax1.axvspan(datetime(2023, 1, 1), datetime(2024, 12, 31), alpha=0.06, color='#FF6B6B', zorder=0)
ax1.text(datetime(2023, 7, 1), 0.55, 'Acceleration Zone: 2023–2024', ha='center', va='center',
         fontsize=9, color='#CC4444', fontweight='bold', style='italic')

# Title
fig.suptitle('The AI Evolution Timeline: Research, Industry & Regulation (2010–2025)', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a1a', y=0.98)
ax1.set_title('Research leads industry by 2–4 years; regulation lags by 3–5 years. ChatGPT (Nov 2022) compressed multi-year lags to months.\n'
              'Investment doubled from $48B (2022) to $96B (2024). More milestones in 2023–2024 than in 2010–2017 combined.',
              fontsize=10, color='#444444', pad=15)

# Legend
legend_elements = [
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=colors['research'], edgecolors='white', label='Research Milestones'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=colors['industry'], edgecolors='white', label='Industry Milestones'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=colors['regulation'], edgecolors='white', label='Regulation Milestones'),
    plt.Line2D([0], [0], color=colors['investment'], linewidth=2.5, linestyle='--', label='AI Investment ($B)'),
    plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#333333', markersize=10, label='Critical event'),
    plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#333333', markersize=7, label='High significance'),
    plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#333333', markersize=5, label='Medium significance'),
]
ax1.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper left', fontsize=8.5, framealpha=0.95, edgecolor='#CCCCCC')

# Clean up spines
ax1.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['left'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax2.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax2.spines['left'].set_visible(False)

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.95])
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=200, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')
plt.close()
print('Saved /app/output/result.png')

    plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#333333', markersize=7, label='High significance'),
    plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#333333', markersize=5, label='Medium significance'),
]
ax1.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper left', fontsize=8.5, framealpha=0.95, edgecolor='#CCCCCC')

# Clean up spines
ax1.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['left'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax2.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax2.spines['left'].set_visible(False)

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.95])
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=200, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')
plt.close()
print('Saved /app/output/result.png')
